unit_note: Measurements shown as metric / US imperial. Temperatures shown as °C / °F. 1 cup = 240ml, 1 tbsp = 15ml, 1 tsp = 5ml, 1 fl oz = 30ml, 1 oz = 28g.

recipes.title: Ginger Bug
recipes.summary: Wild fermented culture: fresh ginger + sugar + water. Captures natural yeast/bacteria from ginger skin into a live starter that carbonates any sweetened liquid.
steps: Day 1: 4 cups (1L) filtered water + 2 tbsp (30ml) chopped ginger + 2 tbsp (30ml / 25g) sugar, stir to dissolve, into Fermenstation jar with lid.
Days 2-7: feed daily with 1 tbsp (15ml) ginger + 1 tbsp (15ml / 12g) sugar, stir, re-cover.
Ready when small bubbles rise on stirring (days 3-4), tangy yeasty smell, lightly sour fizzy taste.
Harvest: strain, discard old ginger, reserve 200ml (¾ cup + 1 tbsp) per soda batch, top up jar to 1L (4¼ cups), feed 1 tbsp each.
Rest: fridge + feed 1 tbsp each once/week. Wake: feed + 12-24h in Fermenstation before use.
recipes.warning_signs: Fuzzy mold (white/green/black/pink) or rotten smell = discard. Thin white film / cloudy liquid = normal.

soda.title: Ginger Bug Soda (ginger ale/beer)
steps: Boil 1L (4¼ cups) water, add ginger/sugar/lemon peel/spices, simmer 5 min, steep until lukewarm (room temp).
Strain bug, measure 200ml (¾ cup), feed the rest.
Strain tea into pitcher, add remaining 2L (8½ cups) water + lemon juice.
Add bug liquid, pour into 4x700ml (3 cup) bottles, 1 inch (2.5cm) headspace, close tight.
F2 ferment 2-3 days, burp to check carbonation.

recipes.title: Ginger Beer
recipes.summary: The classic spicy ginger ale, built from a live ginger bug. Makes 4 x 700ml bottles.
steps: Bring 1L (4¼ cups) water to a boil. Add ginger, sugar, lemon peel, peppercorns, allspice, cloves. Stir until sugar dissolves. Simmer gently 5 min, then remove from heat and steep until lukewarm.
Strain the bug through a mesh strainer and measure out 200ml (¾ cup). Return the rest to the jar, top up with fresh filtered water, and feed 1 tbsp (15ml) each of ginger and sugar.
Once the tea is lukewarm or cooler (hot liquid kills the yeast), strain into a pitcher and discard solids. Add the remaining 2L (8½ cups) room-temperature water and the lemon juice. Stir gently.
Add the 200ml (¾ cup) ginger bug liquid and stir. Pour into 4 x 700ml bottles, leaving 1 inch (2.5cm) headspace. Close tightly.
Ferment in the F2 side for 2-3 days.
Lightly burp the carbonation cap to check fizz. Add days for more fizz.
recipes.prep_tips: Omit the lemon and spices for a simpler version. Refrigerated, keeps a couple weeks and slowly loses sweetness.

recipes.title: Old Thyme Pink Lemonade
recipes.summary: Classic sweet-tart pink lemonade with a grown-up twist.
recipes.prep_tips: Blend berries, lemon juice, and ginger into a puree and double-strain through a fine sieve to reduce pectin and keep the pour clean.

recipes.title: Pineapple Popstar
recipes.summary: Pineapple stays juicy and bright while star anise adds a subtle licorice spice.
recipes.prep_tips: Experiment with the amount of star anise.

recipes.title: Cherry Bomb
recipes.summary: Sweet, jammy cherry leads the flavor while ancho chili adds gentle warmth.

ingredients.name: Ancho chili
ingredients.amount: ½-1 inch / 12-25mm (or a dash of spice)

recipes.prep_tips: Lightly crush the cherries to release juice for carbonation; use a small piece of ancho so the spice infuses without overpowering.

recipes.title: Raspberry Trilogy
recipes.summary: An iconic trio: tart raspberry, bright lemon, and ginger heat that builds on the finish.
recipes.prep_tips: Mash the berries into a paste to release flavor. Grated ginger adds more bite and can boost fizz.

recipes.title: Smokey Margarita
recipes.summary: Bright lime and citrus lead the profile while lapsang souchong tea adds a deep smoky note reminiscent of a mezcal margarita.
recipes.prep_tips: Brew lapsang tea as usual. If the smokiness is too strong, mix with black tea to dilute.

recipes.title: L.A. Fruit Cart
recipes.summary: Juicy mango brings tropical sweetness while Tajín adds a kick of chili, lime, and salt.
recipes.prep_tips: Lightly mash the mango to release more juice for carbonation; start with a small pinch of tajín.

recipes.title: Tropical Hops
recipes.summary: A sunny IPA-style booch with tropical citrus and a floral hop bite.
recipes.prep_tips: Add hops directly and taste at 4-6 hours, then remove. For more intensity, warm-steep the hops (not boiling) 5-10 min, cool, then add.

recipes.title: Blue Sapphire
recipes.summary: Coconut water and ginger with vivid blue spirulina for a striking color.

ingredients.name: Ginger simple syrup (or sugar + ginger juice)

recipes.prep_tips: DIY ginger simple syrup: combine 1 cup (240ml) water + ¾ cup (180ml / 150g) sugar, heat until dissolved. Add 225g (8 oz) peeled cubed ginger, simmer 15 min. Remove from heat and steep 60-90 min. Strain and refrigerate. Makes ~240ml (1 cup). If you have a juicer, swap the syrup for ½ tsp fresh ginger juice.
